name: Provenance
criterion: Every input value has an official source link and retrieval timestamp

name: Point-in-time
criterion: Only data published before the decision timestamp is used; official filing times are respected

name: Pre-registration
criterion: Strategy formula, thresholds and evaluation window are frozen before scoring

name: Minimum sample
criterion: NIST generic advice: 20 observations for a correlation, 32 per group for an average difference, 50 for a standard deviation

name: Out-of-sample
criterion: Model is fit on one partition and assessed on data not used to build it

name: Significance
criterion: Two-sample t-test for equal means with pre-registered alpha and critical region

name: Multiple comparisons
criterion: Every tested strategy is logged so the number of tests is known before scoring

name: Correlation is not causality
criterion: No strategy is described as causal without designed-experiment evidence

name: Parlay/prop correlation guard
criterion: Leg correlations must be measured before combining legs

name: Stability
criterion: Signal must persist across consecutive seasons/weeks

name: Skill over luck
criterion: Performance must exceed a pre-registered skill threshold after all other gates pass

name: Reproducibility
criterion: A script and data snapshot reproduce every published number

name: Deploy integrity
criterion: Every table row has an official source link; no broken internal links; Pages build succeeds
